#### List:

- PC
- PK
- PD

#### Pharmaceutics:

              **Atropine**     **Glycopyrrolate**
  ----------- ---------------- --------------------
  Structure   Tertiary amine   Quaternary amine

#### Pharmacokinetics:

+----------------+------------------------------------------------------------+----------------------------------------------+
|                | **Atropine**                                               | **Glyropyrrolate**                           |
+================+============================================================+==============================================+
| Administration | - 20-30mcg/kg bolus ± repeat                               | - 30-60mcg/kg                                |
+----------------+------------------------------------------------------------+----------------------------------------------+
| Time course    | - Onset 1-2 mins                                           | - Onset 2-3 mins                             |
|                | - Duration 30 mins                                         | - Duration 30 mins (4 hours anti-sialogogue) |
+----------------+------------------------------------------------------------+----------------------------------------------+
| Absorption     | - Oral bioav 25%                                           | - Oral bioav 1-20%                           |
+----------------+------------------------------------------------------------+----------------------------------------------+
| Distribution   | - Crosses blood-brain barrier (BBB)                        | - Doesn’t cross BBB                          |
|                |                                                            | - V~D~ 0.2L/kg                               |
+----------------+------------------------------------------------------------+----------------------------------------------+
| Metabolism     | - 50%                                                      | - Minimal                                    |
|                | - Ester hydrolysis → tropine, tropic acid, glucuronide etc |                                              |
+----------------+------------------------------------------------------------+----------------------------------------------+
| Excretion      | - 50%                                                      | - Near 100%                                  |
+----------------+------------------------------------------------------------+----------------------------------------------+

#### Pharmacodynamics:

+--------------------+--------------------------------------+--------------------------------------+
|                    | **Atropine**                         | **Glycopyrrolate**                   |
+====================+======================================+======================================+
| Receptor activity  | \<2mcg/kg: central effect → ↓HR      | - Partial agonist                    |
+--------------------+--------------------------------------+--------------------------------------+
| CNS effects        | - ↓PONV                              | - Nil                                |
|                    | - Mydriasis                          |                                      |
|                    | - Confusion                          |                                      |
+--------------------+--------------------------------------+--------------------------------------+
| Peripheral effects | - ↑HR                                | - Same                               |
|                    | - Dry mouth                          | - (mild ↑HR due to partial agonism)  |
|                    | - Flushing, fever                    |                                      |
|                    | - Constipation                       |                                      |
|                    | - Urinary retention                  |                                      |
+--------------------+--------------------------------------+--------------------------------------+
| Reversal pairing   | - Atropine 1.2mg                     | - Glycopyrrolate 0.5mg (not 0.4)     |
|                    | - Edrophonium 0.5mg                  | - Neostigmine 2.5mg                  |
+--------------------+--------------------------------------+--------------------------------------+
| Specific use       | - Reversal of neuromuscular blockade | - Reversal of neuromuscular blockade |
|                    | - Emergency treatment of ↓HR         | - Anti-sialagogue                    |
|                    | - Prevent PONV                       |                                      |
|                    | - Treat organophosphate poisoning    |                                      |
+--------------------+--------------------------------------+--------------------------------------+
